messages:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] hosted-api us-west-1 p99 latency spike and sustained queue growth detected. autoscaler retries failing; routing fallbacks recommended.

Alex Chen: seeing p95 jump 1.1s -> 8.6s, p99 ~23s. queue length from 48k -> 120k in ~6m. error rate (5xx) up to 0.9%. dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/hosted/us-west1/queues

Priya Nair: paging SRE. @Maya you oncall? tagging eng-runtime too. any obvious degradation in provisioner?

Maya Patel: oncall, here. looking at provisioner logs now. provisioning latency high, a bunch of "createPool failed: QuotaExceeded" + "provisioner: rateLimit backoff" traces. autoscaler heartbeats intermittently 504.

Javier Torres: Confirmed logs:
```
provisioner.createPool region=us-west1 err=QuotaExceeded: GPUs allowed=0 requested=8
autoscaler: leader-heartbeat timeout=15s instance=prov-13
```
Looks like quota/placement failures, not pure supply.

Alex Chen: customers impacted: a couple of mid-market customers on high-throughput campaigns seeing 503s and timeouts. low-priority trial traffic makes up ~22% of requests — we should throttle non-paid or reroute.

Priya Nair: immediate mitigations: 1) enable fallback routing to smaller quantized model for non-enterprise routes, 2) apply emergency throttle to trial customers, 3) open manual provisioning with cloud quota team.

Maya Patel: doing 1 and 2 now. issuing route patch to point /v1/generate -> model=gptq-7b-fallback for tag=trial. command:
```
curl -X POST https://internal.api/route/update -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' -d '{"filter":"tag:trial","model":"gptq-7b-fallback"}'
```
PATCH applied, traffic shifting (~30s).

Javier Torres: also temporarily lowering low-priority concurrency:
```
curl -X POST https://internal.api/limits -d '{"selector":"plan:trial","concurrency":1}'
```
Done — should cut some inflight.

Alex Chen: can someone call cloud-quota? I can escalate if we need manual increase for us-west1 GPUs.

Maya Patel: I reached out to cloud-quotas slack channel and created ticket #CQ-8942. They responded: investigating placement but not immediate increase.

Priya Nair: while quota works, we should also enable fallback to multi-region (us-east) for critical enterprise customers. Alex can you coordinate cross-region routing?

Alex Chen: on it. will add temporary route override for enterprise tenant IDs. running:
```
internalctl route override --tenant=ENT-342 --region=us-east1 --model=redwood-std-13b
```
Queued, propagation ~45s.

IncidentBot: [UPDATE] after fallback/rate-limits: queue growth reduced from +150% to +20% over 10m. p95 down to 2.4s, p99 ~7.6s. 5xx down to 0.25%.

Maya Patel: provisioning still returning quota errors for new pools. autoscaler still retrying but fewer inflight requests now. we should keep throttles until quota resolved.

Javier Torres: adding a short-term config change to reduce batching window to drop token latency and pressure on KV cache. set batch.window_ms=10.

Alex Chen: changed batch window, small improvement in latency tail.

Priya Nair: customer comms? Support, please prepare note for impacted customers: "We experienced elevated latency and intermittent 5xx due to GPU provisioning limits during a traffic surge. We have mitigations in place (fallback routing, throttles) and are working with cloud provider for capacity. Will follow up with post-incident summary."

Maya Patel: handing off to night oncall (Javier) in 30m. follow-ups: 1) confirm quota ticket progress, 2) run root cause on autoscaler retry/backoff logic, 3) verify routing rollback plan.

Javier Torres: oncall handoff ack. I have runbook link and playbook set: https://runbook.internal/incidents/queue-surge-2026. Will monitor metrics for 2h and escalate if queue growth reappears.

Priya Nair: postmortem owners: eng-runtime (Javier) and infra (Alex). timeline + customer impact + remediation. assign 48h.

Alex Chen: noted. adding follow-up task: add circuit-breaker to stop new pool creation attempts when provider returns QuotaExceeded repeatedly, to avoid autoscaler thundering.

IncidentBot: [RESOLVE-CANDIDATE] metrics stabilized for 15m, queue trending down. please confirm before closing.

Maya Patel: confirmed. leaving throttle and fallback routes in place for now, will remove after quota resolution. handing to Javier for overnight. :thumbsup:
